about: Maps public requirement IDs of the v0.8 requirement list to the tests that cover them in course-core and course-sdk. IDs only; requirement text is not copied here. node scripts/requirements-map.mjs fails on unknown IDs and dangling test references, reports uncovered IDs and fails while any ID listed in critical lacks a behavior-level reference (one naming a test title). A reference is core:<tracked test path> or sdk:<test path at the pinned SDK commit>, optionally ::<text the test file must contain>. Listing a test does not claim the requirement is complete; see the audit for status.

excludedPrefixes.V: Private curriculum requirements are verified in the course repository, not in these public repositories.
